payload.title: Real-model semantic search end-to-end (gated specs)
payload.description:
**Files:** `features/02_querying/09_semantic_model.feature` (new; gating per the decision task); `tests/steps/store_steps.rs`; `src/store/vector.rs`; `src/spec/ch02_querying.rs` (embed).

**Acceptance:** end-to-end, red first then green: ingest with the MiniLM embedder → semantic search returns the semantically right fixtures → hybrid ranking composes. @wip removed only where CI can run the file ungated; stub-based specs unaffected.

Gates: cargo fmt --all; cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings; RUSTDOCFLAGS="-D warnings" cargo doc --no-deps; cargo test and cargo test --test bdd. All existing suites stay green (features/01_structure, features/03_importers, features/04_examples, features/cli).
